# MyPixelGuard

> MyPixelGuard is a free-to-download photo metadata (EXIF) remover and image privacy toolkit for Mac and Windows. It shows what is hidden inside photos, removes it, blurs faces and private text, removes backgrounds, and converts, resizes and compresses images. Everything runs offline on the user's own computer and nothing is uploaded.

It is published by Agentiq BD. The app has no network code, needs no account, and saves cleaned images as new copies without overwriting the originals.

## Product

- [MyPixelGuard home](https://mypixelguard.agentiqbd.com/): what the app does, its tools, and how it protects privacy

- [Offline background remover, a private remove.bg alternative](https://mypixelguard.agentiqbd.com/remove-bg-alternative-offline/): removing image backgrounds on your own computer without uploading
